breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth removed the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly identified this conflict and only included instructions for periodic boundary conditions and periodic wrap-around indexing, completely omitting the erroneous Dirichlet condition.
